Good morning, Professor Alvarez — Omar here. I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week.

My free half-hours next week are:
- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30
- Thursday 10:00-10:30
- Thursday 14:00-14:30

Does any of those work for you? If none does, tell me a time that suits your calendar and I'll see if I can move something.

(I also have standing "Advisor 1:1" blocks on Mon 14:30-15:40, Tue 09:00-10:00 and Fri 13:30-14:20 — say the word if you'd rather use one of those.)
